title: Tornado Safety
description: What to do the moment a tornado warning is issued: the safest shelter in homes, high-rises, schools, mobile homes, and vehicles, and why overpasses are deadly. Covers watches vs. warnings, natural warning signs, and hazards after the storm such as downed lines, gas leaks, and carbon monoxide.
shortDescription: Shelter on a warning: best spots by building, in vehicles, and after the storm
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
